traits.name: Underworld Lore
traits.text: +14 Str +3, Dex +5, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +0 Items +1 striking composite shortbow (20 arrows), lesser darkvision elixir, giant centipede venom (3), invisibility potion, leather armor, +1 rapier, simple injury poison (8 doses, 2d4 (2d4) poison damage), sleep poison (2)

traits.name: Swift Sneak
traits.text: The assassin can move their full Speed when Sneaking.

traits.name: Deny Advantage
traits.text: The assassin isn't flat-footed to creatures of 8th level or lower that are hidden, undetected, flanking, or using surprise attack.

traits.name: Nimble Dodge
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The assassin is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker they can see Effect The assassin gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

traits.name: Poison Weapon
traits.text: ⬻ (manipulate); Requirements The assassin is wielding a piercing or slashing weapon and has a free hand Effect The assassin applies a poison to the weapon.

traits.name: Quick Draw
traits.text: ⬻ The assassin Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The assassin deals an extra 2d6 (2d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.text: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are flatfooted to the assassin.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ rapier +18 (deadly 1d8, disarm, finesse, magical); Damage 1d6+8 (1d6+8) piercing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ composite shortbow +20 (deadly 2d10, magical, propulsive, range increment 60 feet, reload 0); Damage 2d6+4 (2d6+4) piercing
